metadata.title: GameShelf
metadata.description: Track, organize, and discover your video game library.

llm.heading: Game recognition
llm.recommended: Recommended default: Google Gemini ({geminiModel}) — a generous free tier, fast, and reliable at reading box text. OpenAI ({openaiModel}) is a solid paid alternative. Each photo costs one vision call, roughly a fraction of a cent to a few cents depending on provider and image size; recognition is only charged for imported photos.
llm.providerHint: Switching provider resets the saved key and model unless you enter new ones.
llm.baseUrlHint: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint your server exposes (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter).
llm.customModelHint: Enter the exact model name your server exposes — local models have arbitrary names.
llm.customKeyHint: Local servers typically accept any non-empty value. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
llm.modelHint: Leave as the default {model} unless you need a specific model.
llm.keyWillRemove: The key will be removed when you save.
llm.keyHint: Paste a key from {provider}. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
llm.testHint: The test uses the saved settings. Save your changes before testing.

import.title: Import from photos
import.subtitle: Photograph your shelf, pick the photos here, and we’ll recognise the games.

gate.disabled: Photo import is off because no LLM API key is set. Add a key in Settings, then come back — or add games by hand.
gate.unknown: We couldn’t read the LLM settings, so photo import is paused. Try again — or add games by hand.

import.providerNotice: Photos are sent to your configured LLM ({provider}).
import.dropzone: Drop shelf photos here, browse, or paste (⌘V).
import.dropzoneHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC. Up to 20 MB each, up to 50 photos.

rejections.title: Some photos were not added.
rejections.unsupported: Unsupported file type. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
rejections.tooMany: Only {limit, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} can be imported at once.

import.countsHint: If you know how many games are in a photo, add the number. We check it against what the model recognises and flag any difference. Leave it blank if you’d rather not count.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.subtitle: The canonical list every import matches against. Rename keeps the old name as an alias; merge moves games and keeps the merged name matchable.

importReview.title: Added by import — review
importReview.body: These platforms were created while importing for names that weren’t recognized. Keep them as they are, merge them into an existing platform, or rename them. Either way the name stays matchable.

add.title: Add a platform
add.body: Create a platform the import will match against. Names are compared case- and punctuation-insensitively.
add.conflict: It already exists — rename or merge it instead.

platforms.name: Name
platforms.showAll: Show empty and hidden reference platforms

empty.none: No platforms yet. Add one, or import games to create them.
empty.filtered: No platforms to show. Tick “Show empty and hidden reference platforms” to see the full list.

kindHint.import: Created by an import for a name it did not recognize. Keep it as is, or merge it into an existing platform.
kindHint.canonical: Part of the reference list synced from the game database. Matching targets, not user data.
kindHint.manual: A platform you added by hand.

platforms.renameHelp: The previous name is kept as an alias, so future imports still match it.
platforms.hideHint: Reference platforms can’t be deleted — hiding removes them from this list; Refresh platforms restores them.

confirmDelete.title: Delete “{name}”?
confirmDelete.body: This can’t be undone. A platform with games can’t be deleted — you’ll be offered a merge instead.
confirmDelete.blocked: It still has games, so it can’t be deleted yet.
confirmDelete.hint: Reassign its games first — merge it into another platform, or edit each game.

merge.title: Merge “{name}” into another platform
merge.willMove: {count, plural, one {# game will} other {# games will}} move to the target.
merge.move: Move {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} from “{source}”.
merge.none: There is no other platform to merge into yet. Add one first.
merge.confirm: Move {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} from “{source}” to “{target}”? “{source}” is kept as an alias so future imports still match it; the platform is then removed.

status.renamed: Renamed to “{name}”. The previous name is kept as an alias.
